create_language_model_metric_reporter: create a LanguageModelMetricReporter from config to report perplexity metrics for language model evaluation
compute_perplexity_scores: compute sentence-level perplexity scores from model logits and target sequences using cross-entropy loss
get_perplexity_function: get the torch reduction function for a given PerplexityType like MIN, MAX, MEAN, MEDIAN, or EOS
report_masked_lm_metrics: report realtime masked language model training metrics including tokens per second and batch perplexity
aggregate_batch_stats: aggregate batch loss and token counts for language model evaluation across multiple batches
